description: A person's avatar (DESIGN.md, Avatar): round, size by default 40: the image, or initials (weight 600, 36 % of size) on TsuyaColors.fill in TsuyaColors.textMuted, or on a gradient of colors (from the top-start corner at 135°) in white when white keeps 4.5:1 on the darker of the two (checked; falls back to TsuyaColors.fill). Decorative unless it has label.

params.name: image
params.description: The photo; initials show while it is null, loading or failed.

params.name: initials
params.description: Shown while there is no photo, it is loading, or it failed.

params.name: size
params.description: Its width and height, in px. Default 40.

params.name: colors
params.description: A gradient of the person's colours; dropped when white would not reach 4.5:1 on the darker one.

params.name: label
params.description: The accessible name; decorative when left out.

params.name: badge
params.description: Pinned on the corner; fold its meaning into label.
